name: settings-02
title: Settings 02
description: A settings page of notification switches and a danger zone.

files.content:
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { disabled, form, FormField } from '@angular/forms/signals'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogMedia, AlertDialogTitle, } from '@/ui/alert-dialog/alert-dialog'; import { Button } from '@/ui/button/button'; import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, } from '@/ui/card/card'; import { Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSet, } from '@/ui/form-field/form-field'; import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupIndicator, RadioGroupItem, } from '@/ui/radio-group/radio-group'; import { Separator } from '@/ui/separator/separator'; import { Switch, SwitchThumb } from '@/ui/switch/switch'; import { NdAlertDialog as AlertDialog, NdAlertDialogTrigger as AlertDialogTrigger, } from '@ndop/primitives/alert-dialog'; /** One notification switch: its form key, label and help text. */ interface NotificationRow { readonly key: 'digest' | 'product' | 'security' | 'mentions' | 'reminders'; readonly label: string; readonly description: string; } /** * A notification settings page: switches grouped by channel, which apply * as soon as they change (security alerts can't be turned off), a choice * of what to be notified about, and a danger zone whose "Delete account" * asks for confirmation in an alert dialog first. */ @Component({ selector: 'block-settings-02', imports: [ AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogMedia, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogTrigger, Button, Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle, Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSet, FormField, NdIcon, RadioGroup, RadioGroupIndicator, RadioGroupItem, Separator, Switch, SwitchThumb, ], template: `

Notifications

Choose how and when we get in touch with you.

Channels

Changes are saved as soon as you make them.

@for (group of groups; track group.id; let last = $last) {

{{ group.title }}

@for (row of group.rows; track row.key; let lastRow = $last) {

{{ row.description }}

@if (!lastRow) {
} }
@if (!last) {
} }

Activity

Pick which conversations reach you on every channel.

Notify me about
@for (option of notifyOptions; track option.value) {

{{ option.description }}

}

Danger zone

Actions here are permanent. Take a moment before you go on.

Delete account

Deletes your profile, projects and files for good.

Delete your account?

Your profile, 12 projects and their files are deleted for everyone. This can't be undone.

@if (deleted()) { Your account is scheduled for deletion. We've emailed you a link to cancel within 14 days. }

`, }) export class Settings02Block { protected readonly groups: readonly { readonly id: string; readonly title: string; readonly icon: string; readonly rows: readonly NotificationRow[]; }[] = [ { id: 'email', title: 'Email', icon: 'mail', rows: [ { key: 'digest', label: 'Weekly digest', description: 'A summary of activity in your projects, every Monday.', }, { key: 'product', label: 'Product updates', description: 'New features, improvements and the occasional tip.', }, { key: 'security', label: 'Security alerts', description: 'Sign-ins from new devices and password changes. Always on.', }, ], }, { id: 'push', title: 'Push', icon: 'bell', rows: [ { key: 'mentions', label: 'Mentions', description: 'When someone mentions you in a comment or a task.', }, { key: 'reminders', label: 'Reminders', description: 'Due dates and reminders you set yourself.', }, ], }, ]; protected readonly notifyOptions = [ { value: 'all', label: 'All new activity', description: 'Every comment, task and status change.', }, { value: 'mentions', label: 'Direct messages and mentions', description: 'Only what is addressed to you.', }, { value: 'none', label: 'Nothing', description: 'Security alerts still reach you by email.', }, ]; protected readonly model = signal({ digest: true, product: false, security: true, mentions: true, reminders: false, notify: 'mentions', }); protected readonly settings = form(this.model, (path) => { disabled(path.security); }); protected readonly deleted = signal(false); }

docs: Route to it, for example: { path: 'settings-02', loadComponent: () => import('./blocks/settings-02/settings-02').then((m) => m.Settings02Block) }
